content_sections.text: WBPSC has announced 266 vacancies for recruitment to Schedule A and Schedule B English Stenographer (Basic Grade) cadres.

tables.caption: WBPSC English Stenographer Category-Wise Vacancy Details

content_sections.heading: WBPSC English Stenographer Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates must meet the prescribed educational qualification, computer typing requirement, language eligibility and age conditions. Applicants must have passed the Madhyamik Examination conducted by the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education or an equivalent examination . Candidates must be capable of typing in English on a computer at the prescribed speed. Candidates must have the ability to read, write and speak Bengali. This requirement does not apply to applicants whose mother tongue is Nepali. For candidates whose mother tongue is neither Bengali nor Nepali, knowledge of Bengali will be tested during the computer typing test. Poor performance in this language assessment may lead to cancellation of candidature. Applicants must be Indian citizens or belong to another nationality declared eligible by the Government of India, subject to the prescribed certificate-of-eligibility requirements.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC English Stenographer Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: The prescribed age limit is 18 to 44 years as of 1 January 2025 . The date of birth recorded in the Madhyamik or equivalent certificate will be accepted for determining age eligibility. Candidates claiming age relaxation must satisfy the respective category and certificate requirements.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC English Stenographer Selection Process 2026
content_sections.text: The recruitment examination consists of three papers carrying a combined maximum of 600 marks . Paper I: General English examination. Paper II: Dictation and Transcription examination. Paper III: Computer Typing examination. Final merit preparation using the combined marks obtained in all three papers, subject to qualifying criteria. Medical fitness examination and verification of antecedents before appointment. The Commission will first conduct Paper I. Based on Paper I results, a limited number of candidates will be admitted to Paper II and Paper III. Final Merit Rule: The final merit list will be prepared using the combined marks in Paper I, Paper II and Paper III. Paper I is not merely a qualifying screening examination; its marks also contribute to final merit.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC English Stenographer Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: The Commission has specified the following category-wise minimum aggregate qualifying marks across the three papers. Important: The aggregate qualifying marks do not replace the separate qualifying standards that the Commission may prescribe for individual papers. WBPSC also reserves the discretion to relax qualifying marks under the advertised conditions. If candidates obtain equal aggregate marks, the Commission will apply the following preference order: Higher marks in the Dictation and Transcription paper. Higher marks in the Computer Typing paper. Higher accuracy marks in the typing paper. Higher marks for typing speed. Higher age of the candidate.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC English Stenographer Reservation Rules
content_sections.text: SC, ST, OBC Non-Creamy Layer and EWS reservation benefits are available to eligible West Bengal candidates. Candidates belonging to these categories from other states will be considered for unreserved vacancies. OBC Non-Creamy Layer candidates must provide valid renewed or revalidated certificates at the prescribed stages. EWS applicants must provide the prescribed Income and Asset Certificate. Reservation claims must be made while submitting the online application and supported by certificates issued by the competent authority. The notification provides reserved vacancies for eligible Meritorious Sportspersons (MSP) in recognized competitions. The notified sports include Athletics, Badminton, Basketball, Cricket, Football, Hockey, Swimming, Table Tennis, Volleyball, Tennis, Weightlifting, Wrestling, Boxing, Cycling, Gymnastics, Judo, Rifle Shooting, Kabaddi, Kho-Kho and Archery. Eligible applicants must furnish the prescribed sports certificate and the applicable Form 1, 2, 3 or 4 issued by the competent authority.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC English Stenographer Application Correction Window 2026
content_sections.text: WBPSC will provide a limited opportunity to edit permitted application fields from 10 November to 13 November 2026, up to 3:30 PM . Candidates will be allowed to edit only certain fields. Applicants wishing to change their address must first make the relevant change in their profile and then use the Edit option. Important: The Edit facility can be used only once. No correction requests will be entertained after the prescribed closing date.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for WBPSC English Stenographer Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Application Warning: Submission of more than one application by the same candidate is prohibited and may lead to cancellation of candidature. Candidates must ensure that their category, qualification and personal details are accurate before final submission.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required for WBPSC English Stenographer Recruitment
content_sections.text: Candidates should retain the following documents and produce them as required during examination or verification. Madhyamik or equivalent examination certificate and marksheet. Proof of date of birth recorded in the Madhyamik or equivalent certificate. Valid photo identity proof. SC/ST/OBC Non-Creamy Layer certificate, if applicable. EWS Income and Asset Certificate, if applicable. PwBD Certificate, if applicable. Prescribed certificate supporting scribe or compensatory-time requirements, where applicable. Meritorious Sportsperson certificate and prescribed form, if applicable. Other documents requested by WBPSC for eligibility and appointment verification. Permitted photo identity documents include a Madhyamik or equivalent certificate bearing a photograph, Passport, PAN Card, Voter Identity Card, Driving Licence or other government-issued identity proof, as specified in the notification.

content_sections.heading: WBPSC English Stenographer Examination and Posting Details
content_sections.text: The examination is tentatively scheduled for December 2026 at different centres in Kolkata. Candidates must attend the examination centre allotted on their admit card. Schedule A posts cover specified Secretariat, senior administrative and directorate offices, while Schedule B covers other notified directorate and stenographer positions in the West Bengal Government. Appointments are subject to the Commission's merit and eligibility requirements, medical fitness and verification of antecedents by the competent authorities.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are advertised under WBPSC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: A total of 266 vacancies are advertised, comprising 146 vacancies for Schedule ‘A’ and 120 vacancies for Schedule ‘B’.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit online applications?
faq.answer: The last date for submission of online applications and fees through online mode is 7th November, 2026 (upto 3:30 pm).

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the posts?
faq.answer: Passed in Madhyamik Examination of the West Bengal Board of Secondary Education or its equivalent; and elementary knowledge in Computer Operation with the ability of typing on computer at the speed of 30 (thirty) words per minute in English.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the examination?
faq.answer: Not below 18 years but not more than 44 years as on 01.01.2025 (i.e. born not earlier than 2nd Jan, 1981 and not later than 1st Jan, 2007).

faq.question: Q5. Are there any age relaxations?
faq.answer: Yes, upper age limit is relaxable by 5 years for S.C. & S.T. candidates and by 3 years for O.B.C. (non-creamy layer) candidates of West Bengal, and upto 45 years for PwBD. Permanent Schedule-B Stenographers, Permanent Typists, Permanent Steno-Typists and Permanent Clerk-cum-Typists in service under W.B. Govt. have no age limit.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: Rs.160/- plus service charges. SC/ST candidates of West Bengal and PwBD candidates having physical disability of 40% and above are not required to pay any fee.

faq.question: Q7. What are the stages of the selection process?
faq.answer: Paper-I (General English), Paper-II (Dictation & Transcription), and Paper-III (Computer Typing), followed by a final merit list prepared based on marks obtained in all three papers taken together, and medical examination/antecedent verification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the pay scale for English Stenographer posts?
faq.answer: Pay Level-9 ('₹' 28,900/- - '₹' 74,500/-) under W.B.S (ROPA) Rules-2019.

faq.question: Q9. Where will the examination be held?
faq.answer: The examination will be held at various centres in Kolkata tentatively in December, 2026 or thereabout.

faq.question: Q10. How can candidates contact for further assistance?
faq.answer: Candidates may contact via email at [email protected] on any working day from 11:00 a.m. to 4:00 p.m.
